protocol:
Electroporation Protocol (C2986)
Prepare 17mm x 100mm round-bottom culture tubes (e.g. VWR #60818-667) at room temperature. 
Place SOC recovery medium in a 37°C water bath. 
Pre-warm selective plates at 37°C for 1 hour. 
Place electroporation cuvettes (1mm) and microcentrifuge tubes on ice. 
As a positive control for transformation, dilute the control pUC19 by 1:5 to a final concentration of 10 pg/μl using sterile water. 
Thaw NEB Turbo Electrocompetent cells on ice (about 10 min) and mix cells by flicking gently. 
Transfer 25 μl of the cells (or the amount specified for the cuvettes) to a chilled microcentrifuge tube. 
Add 1 μl of the DNA solution.
Carefully transfer the cell/DNA mix into a chilled cuvette without introducing bubbles and make sure that the cells deposit across the bottom of the cuvette. 
Electroporate using the following conditions for BTX ECM 630 and Bio-Rad GenePulser electroporators: 2.1 kV, 100 Ω, and 25 μF.
The typical time constant is ~2.6 milliseconds. 
Immediately add 975 µl of 37°C SOC to the cuvette. 
Gently mix up and down twice. 
Transfer to the 17mm x 100mm round-bottom culture tube.
Shake vigorously (250 rpm) or rotate at 37°C for 1 hour. 
Dilute the cells as appropriate then spread 100-200 μl cells onto a pre-warmed selective plate. 
Incubate plates 8 hours to overnight at 37°C.

other.note: without introducing bubbles, ensure cells deposit across bottom

# Lab Automation Script

### MANUAL SECTION ###

# MANUAL: place (container: SOC recovery medium, temperature: 37°C, other: {'location': 'water bath'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
pre-warm(container='selective plates', temperature='37°C', duration='1 hour')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: place (container: electroporation cuvettes (1mm) and microcentrifuge tubes, temperature: on ice)

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
dilute(reagent='control pUC19', dilution='1:5', final concentration='10 pg/μl', diluent='sterile water')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: thaw (container: NEB Turbo Electrocompetent cells, temperature: on ice, duration: about 10 min)

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
mix(container='NEB Turbo Electrocompetent cells', speed='by flicking gently')
transfer(container='chilled microcentrifuge tube', reagent='NEB Turbo Electrocompetent cells', volume='25 μl (or amount specified for cuvettes)', temperature='chilled')
add(container='chilled microcentrifuge tube', reagent='DNA solution', volume='1 μl')
transfer(container='chilled cuvette', reagent='cell/DNA mix', volume='entire mix', temperature='chilled', note='without introducing bubbles, ensure cells deposit across bottom')
electroporate(container='cuvette', reagent='cell/DNA mix', device='BTX ECM 630 or Bio-Rad GenePulser', settings={'voltage': '2.1 kV', 'resistance': '100 Ω', 'capacitance': '25 μF'}, time constant='~2.6 ms')
add(container='cuvette', reagent='SOC', volume='975 μl', temperature='37°C', duration='immediately after electroporation')
mix(container='cuvette', reagent='cell/SOC mix', volume='entire contents', speed='up and down twice, gently')
transfer(container='17mm x 100mm round-bottom culture tube', reagent='cell/SOC mix', volume='entire contents')
shake(container='culture tube', temperature='37°C', duration='1 hour', speed='250 rpm', alternative='rotate')
dilute(reagent='cells', note='as appropriate')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: spread (container: pre-warmed selective plate, reagent: cells, volume: 100-200 μl)

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='plates', temperature='37°C', duration='8 hours to overnight')
